Verified on `origin/main` @ `12841b6`: declaration at `packages/app-shell/src/layout/inboxGrouping.ts:41` (`actor_name?: string | null`); `mergeInboxRows` (`packages/app-shell/src/hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts:675`) maps the row fields and not `actor_name`; a full `actor_name` grep over `packages/app-shell/src` hits only the decoy shapes the body itself flags (the `sys_activity`→`ActivityItem` map at `sharedUserFeeds.ts:587`, approvals at `useRecordApprovals.ts:141` / `RecordApprovalsPanel.tsx:303`, fixtures) and zero inbox renderers — with those sibling files as the positive control.

No fresh escalation needed: the ruling is inherited — #5190 ruled removal for two sibling fields of the *same interface* (landed as PR #5204), and this card is strictly milder (no reader at all, vs a reader of never-produced data). "Make it live" would be a capability expansion with zero measured demand. Scope: delete the one line + any type-echo; a changeset note for the published type narrowing (an unfilled optional field has no plausible external reader — if the dev finds one, that is a fork report, not a silent widen). Serial: the file's recent churn (#5204) is merged; no open PR. Size suggestion: S, sonnet–opus.
